summary: Day-2 perf sprint verification: 30+ React.lazy() routes + lazy TipTap visual editor. Tested 14 review items end-to-end against the preview URL. Every route loads (no white screen, no infinite spinner, no 404 on the lazy chunk), Suspense fallback clears, and TipTap mounts on demand the first time an author opens the essay visual editor. No regressions detected. Main bundle drop (711kB -> 155kB gzipped) is safe to ship.

minor.issue: Pre-existing 401/404 console noise on / and /signin and /essays (member-only endpoints probed while anonymous). Identical to iteration_29 baseline — unrelated to lazy-loading change.

critical_code_review_comments: App.js: RouteFallback is layout-neutral (sits INSIDE ChromeLayout) so the header/footer never blank during chunk fetch. Good UX choice — verified visually that nav never flashes a full-page spinner.
App.js: Landing, SignIn, AuthCallback, AggHome are kept eager — correct call, these are the two highest-traffic surfaces + auth-handoff page. AggHome stays eager which preserves the /news LCP.

App.js: AuthCallback is rendered directly when location.hash includes session_id= (line 97-99). It is NOT lazy in this branch — good, because the OAuth round-trip must run immediately without waiting for a chunk.

Composer.jsx: RichTextEditor is dynamic-imported (line 11) with a Suspense + rte-loading fallback (line 403-414). TipTap mounts cleanly on first visual-mode toggle; markdown mode never pays the tiptap cost. Verified .ProseMirror present after clicking essay-editor-visual.
Composer.jsx: Suspense wrapper is only mounted when isEssay && editorMode === 'visual' — so the chunk fetch is deferred until the author actually needs it. Good.

Pre-existing tiptap 'Duplicate extension names found: [link]' warning still surfaces (unchanged from iteration_29). Not a regression of this PR but worth a separate fix at some point in RichTextEditor.jsx (likely Link extension registered twice via StarterKit + custom).
